items.text: Tuesday's MRI showed a torn patellar tendon in the left knee of Terry McLaurin (WAS), and Dan Quinn said he needs surgery and misses the rest of the season. Stefon Diggs is the top receiver when Washington returns in Week 8, WR30 rest of season for me. Drop McLaurin for any add; hold Diggs.

items.why: A second straight game with Corey Kiner taking the late carries makes him a sell.
items.text: TreVeyon Henderson (NE) practiced in full Monday and Tuesday on the ankle before Thursday at CHI, but Corey Kiner closed out the Jets after Henderson's fumble. RB26 rest of season for me. Hold Henderson; a second straight game with Kiner taking the late carries makes him a sell.

items.why: Missing Wednesday's practice before the Thursday game changes it.
items.text: A.J. Brown (NE) was limited Monday and Tuesday with the ankle but is not expected to miss Thursday at CHI. He ran a route on 97 percent of the dropbacks and drew 10 targets vs NYJ, and Romeo Doubs is on IR. WR24 rest of season for me; hold him through the drops.

Kyle Monangai (CHI) missed practice again Tuesday with the thumb and toe and is very unlikely to play Thursday vs NE, a third straight game out. RB29 rest of season for me. Monitor Chicago's Wednesday practice report. D'Andre Swift leads the backfield again, RB13 rest of season for me; hold him.

items.watch: his route share vs NYG Sunday
items.text: Houston plans to activate Tank Dell (HOU) off IR for Week 7 vs NYG, his first game since the 2024 knee injury. He plays the slot, so Jaylin Noel and the depth receivers lose snaps first. Monitor his route share vs NYG Sunday before you add him.

Jaylin Noel (HOU) caught 4 for 107 and a TD on 4 targets at JAX on 63 percent of the routes, but Tank Dell returns to share the slot vs NYG. Add him in deep leagues, 1 to 3 percent of FAAB and no more.
Matt LaFleur would not commit to Josh Jacobs (GB) playing Week 7 at DET, though Jacobs is off the exempt list and eligible. RB37 rest of season for me. Monitor Green Bay's Wednesday practice report.
MarShawn Lloyd (GB) ran 8 times for 10 and played 30 snaps vs DAL, 11 fewer than the back ahead of him, and Josh Jacobs is eligible again. RB41 rest of season for me; drop him for any add.

Mike Macdonald said there is a good chance Zach Charbonnet (SEA) plays Week 7 vs KC. The fill-ins split 46 and 27 snaps Sunday, so the early downs are his when he is back. RB47 rest of season for me. Monitor Seattle's Wednesday practice report.

items.watch: his activation off IR before Sunday vs IND
items.text: Minnesota designated Jordan Mason (MIN) to return from IR, opening his practice window before Week 7 vs IND, and he takes early downs once active. RB35 rest of season for me. Monitor his activation before Sunday; hold Aaron Jones Sr. until then.
Jesse Minter called Lamar Jackson (BAL) day to day with the ankle and said he could practice this week. QB2 rest of season for me. Monitor Baltimore's Wednesday practice report.

The Giants released Najee Harris (NYG) on Tuesday, per NFL Network's Ian Rapoport and ESPN's Jordan Raanan, after 31 carries for 99 yards in five games, 3.2 a carry, and 4 for 2 vs NO. Drop him in every format.

With Najee Harris gone, the Giants are down to three backs at Houston: Devin Singletary played 40 percent of the snaps vs NO, Tyrone Tracy Jr. (NYG) 38 percent with two TDs on 8 touches, and Cam Skattebo 6 snaps. Add Tracy, 0 to 2 percent of FAAB; he is the bench piece if John Harbaugh leans on him.

Mike Evans (SF) has Achilles tendinitis that flared up Monday night, and Kyle Shanahan said it is not a long-term problem. NBC Sports Bay Area reports the Achilles is intact but San Francisco is bracing for him to miss at ATL, with the bye in Week 8. He is WR26 rest of season for me. Monitor; San Francisco's Wednesday practice report.

Baker Mayfield (TB) is set to practice Wednesday on the dislocated right thumb, but Fox Sports' Greg Auman reports Todd Bowles is still planning for Jalon Daniels to make a fourth straight start at CAR. Mayfield is QB24 rest of season for me. Monitor; Tampa Bay's Wednesday practice report.

Jeremiyah Love (ARI) was expected to do some running Tuesday on the ankle, per Mike LaFleur, after missing Week 6 at LAR, where Bam Knight ran 15 times for 80. Love is RB15 rest of season for me. Monitor; Arizona's Wednesday practice report before at DEN.
